answer: Bind every identity to one hardware enclave: each agent registers a unique TPM attestation key, and the network verifies it with an attestation challenge no emulator can pass. A second identity on the same chip is rejected, and a 250 POA bond burns when a forged key is caught. Re-keying takes 45 days of quarantine. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 SGX machines at $300 each, $3,000,000, plus 2,500,000 POA in bonds. Like an oasis in a desert, one real spring is precious; a lagoon of fake water only fools the thirsty until they touch it, and ferrous truth rusts every counterfeit key.
